report.season.model.changxia: Late summer ({zh}) is counted as a season of its own, between summer and autumn.
report.season.model.explain.changxia: Schools of Chinese medicine divide the year in different ways. This app counts late summer as a season of its own, between summer and autumn, and says so on every result. The other reading, in which the earth phase commands the last 18 days of each season, is not used here. The choice changes only the season block of the reference, never how your symptoms are scored.
report.season.model.explain.tuwang18: Schools of Chinese medicine divide the year in different ways. This result counts the earth phase as commanding the last 18 days before each change of season, with no late summer of its own. The usual reading, in which late summer is a season between summer and autumn, is not used for it. The choice changes only the season block of the reference, never how your symptoms are scored.
